scenarios.name: max-speed-not-yet-reached
scenarios.why: Controlling a start-your-engines permanent begins speed at one, below the maximum of four, so its conditional haste activation is not available.

scenarios.name: max-speed-after-opponent-loses-life-on-three-turns
scenarios.why: The player begins at speed one and can increase speed once on each of their turns when an opponent loses life; three such turn-specific increases reach speed four, enabling the haste activation.
